verdicts.reason: A squeezes the headline into two wide lines that nearly touch the left and right edges, and puts the whole text-and-button group in the upper middle. That leaves almost half the canvas below the CTA (the 'See the Flavours' button) as empty orange, which is lopsided and looks like a reused banner layout. B rewraps the headline into four large lines that suit the taller format and keeps the CTA clearly below it with good margins. Its only flaw is that the space above the headline is somewhat bigger than the space below the button, so the content sits slightly low.
